re_engagement_plan.who: 2,770 unengaged profiles: 1,850 never engaged (no open or click since they joined) and 920 lapsed (engaged before, quiet for 180 days), 230 of them lapsed buyers.
re_engagement_plan.winback_for_lapsed_buyers: First, the 230 lapsed buyers: 3 emails over about 3 weeks in the Win-back: cancelled accounts flow. Open with what shipped since they left (two-way calendar sync and class booking, the two launches the last 90 days of campaigns announced), then a plain reason to come back. The account has 1 real coupon (ANNUAL15); offer it only if you say yes.
re_engagement_plan.lapsed_non_buyers: The other 690 lapsed profiles get the same first email, without an offer, before they enter the sunset.
re_engagement_plan.sunset_for_never_engaged: 1,850 profiles: 2 emails a week apart asking whether they still want booking tips and product news, with one button to stay. Anyone who doesn't click is suppressed after the second email, only with your yes.
re_engagement_plan.measure: the share of each group that clicks, and Placed Order revenue from each group, in the 30 days after the last email
re_engagement_plan.expected_effect: Suppressing the never-engaged lowers the bounce and complaint rates of every later send. No revenue number is promised: the win-back flow has never sent, so there is no baseline yet.
